finger_support: Closed source polygons associated with the accepted named source track, plus no source-surface crossings on complete continuous path and phalange segments. No finger seam reconstruction or exterior placement allowance.
garment_provenance: Existing character-local principal garment classification anchors; same original object and unambiguous material.
